chapter_theme: The excellence of giving (தானச் சிறப்பு): give to anyone without discrimination, look for others before eating, don't hoard, and learn from the crow that calls its kin before it eats.

250.reading: Give to everyone without asking who they are; look out for others before you eat; don't hoard old goods; you who are hungry, don't hurry to eat alone; know the hour when the crow calls out and then eats.
250.nuance: Five commands in four lines, closing on the crow that calls its flock to food, an old Tamil image of sharing. அவரிவர் என்னன்மின், 'don't say this one or that one', rules out choosing worthy recipients.

links.note: Both use the crow that calls its flock before eating: the Kural for the wealth that comes to those who keep kin close, Tirumular as a lesson in giving.
Both say to share food with all before eating, friend or not; the Naladiyar warns that the door of the other world is shut on those who shut their door and eat.
